title: Hybrid Expense Tracker
description:
Privacy-first financial tracking platform with real-time multi-device sync, end-to-end secure data handling, and offline resilience — built for performance at scale.

Key Technical Highlights:
• Real-time multi-device state synchronization powered by Socket.IO & Firebase.
• Privacy-first architecture with client-side cryptographic hashing and secure financial record isolation.
• Offline-first capability with IndexedDB hybrid storage and automatic conflict-free background synchronization.
• Multi-account ledger management, split expenses, recurring billing alerts, and detailed visual budget analytics.

title: Live Chat Application
description:
High-throughput real-time chat system with multi-room conversations, live presence indicators, and persistent message history — engineered for concurrent connections at scale.

Key Technical Highlights:
• Scalable event-driven architecture using Socket.IO with automatic reconnection and heartbeat monitoring.
• Relational message persistence using PostgreSQL & TypeORM with indexed cursor pagination for rapid historical message retrieval.
• Real-time presence indicators, typing status, user avatars, and dynamic room channels.
• End-to-end message delivery acknowledgments with optimistic UI rendering.

title: Cloud-Based Image Recognition System
description:
Containerized microservice on GCP Cloud Run for rapid object detection and image analysis, with Docker-based horizontal scaling and reproducible deployments.

Key Technical Highlights:
• Containerized with Docker and deployed to Google Cloud Platform (Cloud Run) for auto-scaling on demand.
• Automated object detection, label classification, optical character recognition (OCR), and visual landmark identification.
• Asynchronous batch image processing pipeline built in Python and Node.js with optimized image transformation buffers.
• Zero-config horizontal scaling with sub-second cold start and reproducible container images.

title: TaskFlow – Smart Task Visualization
description:
Graph-based task management tool with hierarchical dependency visualization and real-time Firestore sync — reducing cognitive overhead in complex project planning.

Key Technical Highlights:
• Interactive hierarchical dependency graph visualization built with React and D3.js.
• Real-time cloud state synchronization and live collaborative updates via Firebase Firestore.
• Intelligent critical-path calculation, blocker identification, and priority matrix filtering.
• Responsive canvas with pan-zoom controls, hierarchical node collapse/expand, and drag-and-drop hierarchy restructuring.

title: Project Management System
description:
A centralized academic supervision and project administration platform enabling faculty to coordinate, review, and evaluate student engineering projects.

Key Technical Highlights:
• Multi-role authorization for faculty supervisors, evaluators, and student teams.
• Automated submission pipelines, milestone tracking, and email notification triggers.
• Relational and document data modeling for project artifacts, version histories, and grading rubrics.

title: Vaidyatrix Android App
description:
A specialized healthcare SaaS Android application developed for medical practitioners to streamline clinical records, eliminate paperwork, and safely archive patient histories.

Key Technical Highlights:
• Native Android UI built with Java and XML adhering to Material Design guidelines.
• Secure cloud document and medical scan storage integrated with AWS S3.
• Offline record caching with background synchronization upon network reconnection.
